course.title: Utility Services and Infrastructure Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Discuss inelasticity of water demand with examples. In a residential area of (13) 300,000 inhabitants, the specific water demand is estimated as 150 l/d, which includes leakage. Calculate the demand in 15 years' time if the assumed annual demand growth is 3.5%. Compare the results by applying the linear and exponential models.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
